newsitem.title: USA: Interstate, Host Marriott buys hotel.
newsitem.headline: Interstate, Host Marriott buys hotel.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said Monday that it and Host Marriott Corp purchased the Manhattan Beach Radisson Plaza in Manhattan Beach, Calif., for $38.25 million.
Interstate said it owns a 25 percent interest in the hotel and will remain as manager of the property.
The property will be immediately converted to a Marriott, Interstate said.
The property is a 380-room full-service hotel three miles from Los Angeles International Airport.
Interstate said it has managed the hotel since 1991.
About $6.8 million of capital expenditures have been allocated to convert the property, Interstate said.
